title: transformers
summary: Hugging Face Transformers is a state-of-the-art library providing pre-trained models, data processing tools, and high-level APIs for various machine learning tasks across modalities. It enables researchers and developers to easily access, fine-tune, and deploy powerful models for natural language processing, computer vision, and audio applications. The library focuses on ease of use, performance optimization, and broad compatibility with popular deep learning frameworks.
